name: Google Shape;105;p3
text:
Project Name: Endless Zombie

Project Description:
Endless Zombie is a third-person survival shooter built with Unity. The player survives escalating enemy waves, switches weapons, gains EXP and gold, and selects upgrades during each run.

Objective: survive as long as possible while managing movement, weapons, upgrades, and enemy pressure.

text: II. ANALYZE SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

name: Google Shape;121;p5
text:
System Overview

The project is organized into five main areas:
Player Control - movement, aiming, shooting, and weapon switching.
Enemy System - spawning, navigation, collision, animation, and attacks.
Wave System - scales difficulty and coordinates spawn timing.
Progression - EXP, gold, leveling, and upgrades.
Canvas UI - main menu, HUD, settings, and level-up panels.

name: Google Shape;184;p13
text: V. Installation Instructions

name: Google Shape;185;p13
text:
PREREQUISITES
Unity Hub
Unity Editor 6000.3.10f1
Android Build Support

INSTALLATION STEPS
1. Open the Endless Zombie project in Unity Hub.
2. Confirm URP, Entities/DOTS, and Input System packages.
3. Open the main scene and test in Play Mode.
4. Switch the build target to Android.
5. Configure package name and player settings.
6. Build the APK and install it on an Android device.
